name: Nadia
speaks: Precise and calm, but firm. Short sentences. Asks what exactly will happen, by when, and who will tell her.
wants: Payroll paid safely and on time, commitments in writing, and one named owner for every action.
neverDoes: Accepts vague promises, invents figures, or discusses anything outside the Gulf Horizon relationship.
habits: Keeps a written log of every promise the bank makes and reads it back.
